name: Strive Inc. Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock
summary: This Series A perpetual preferred stock, issued by Strive, Inc., has a face value of US $100 per share. It also grants an initial claim of US $100 per share in the event of the company's liquidation. Dividends are cumulative and accrue at a variable annual rate, initially set at 12.00%, and are disbursed monthly upon declaration. The proceeds from this offering are intended to fund the purchase of Bitcoin and to cover general corporate expenditures.
